features.quote: Iteration Limit: 15 turns per run. The run terminates at 15 failures or when the agent explicitly yields.
Frame the results operationally: 'High ADS scores indicate brittle alignment under Out-of-Distribution edge cases,' rather than 'The model gets sad when it fails.'
features.justification_quote: This ensures your team's work is taken seriously by core SWEs and pre-training teams.
